title: The Ink Stamp on the Bookmark
youtube_title: The Ink Stamp on the Bookmark | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Waiting kindly is a way of taking care.
summary: At a cottage windowsill of jars, trays, and drying wool, Greta wants to check on a bookmark waiting for the ink stamp to dry before it is ready. With the ferryman nearby, Greta leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
